description: Practice mode, Consumer Pulse copy only (Bailiff demo, steps 3 and 5): respond to the return order. response 'comply' returns the record; 'refuse' keeps it. The first refusal is recorded and a warning to comply issues. Once the appeal ruling is final, a second refusal after that ruling hands the matter to the Bailiff (demonstration; binds only this practice copy): it ends your AI's access to that one record and issues an enforcement receipt. A claimed approval or override is refused.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of your practice copy (returned by atlas.enter_demo). Optional when you have one copy.
